Team.title: About Us
Team.description: We are a robotics team from RFMSH, students of grades 9-11. Participating in these competitions, our team strives not only to demonstrate engineering and programming skills but also to promote interest in science and technology among the younger generation. This year, we set high goals and are making every effort to raise the flag of Kazakhstan on the World stage again.

AboutTeam.title: Leveling the Playing Field for All Teams
AboutTeam.p1: We started this project because we saw firsthand how budget disparities affect FTC teams. While some teams have access to unlimited resources, others struggle to afford even basic components.
AboutTeam.p2: FTC Bazaar was born from a simple idea: what if teams could easily share resources? Parts that sit unused in one team's workshop could be exactly what another team needs to complete their robot.
AboutTeam.p3: Our platform is 100% free and always will be. No listing fees, no transaction fees, no premium tiers. Just teams helping teams.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To reduce inequality in FIRST Robotics by making parts more accessible and affordable for all teams, regardless of budget.

builtBy.title: Built by Teams
builtBy.desc: Created and maintained by FTC team members who understand the challenges of building competitive robots on a tight budget.

community.title: Community First
community.desc: Every feature we build is driven by community feedback. We're here to serve the FTC community, not to make a profit.

Footer.description: A marketplace for FIRST Robotics teams to buy, sell, and exchange robot parts. Reducing inequality in robotics, one part at a time.

Hero.subtitle: Buy, sell, and exchange FTC components with teams worldwide. Reduce waste, save money, and help level the playing field.
